# Frozen pre-rewrite comparison

These are the author-qualified, description-corrected BASIC game and its
native CVB2 launcher, captured before the structural rewrite. The source was
unchanged between gameplay commit 652a162 and baseline snapshot commit 7118774.
Copyright/provenance remain in the BAS header and repository GPL licence.

`fixture.json` records the COM/source/compiler/RTL hashes and actual native
symbol addresses. `loader.json` records the qualified old RNG and overlay
addresses. CAVLOAD.COM differs from CAVBASIC.COM only in the opening banner.
The fixtures are development-only; none is added to the starter disk.

Use them for actual native binary comparisons, not as the current release.
